subject: general
question: Who among the following has written the fiction ’Noddy and His Car’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Enid Blyton**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Enid Blyton**, an **English children's author**, invented the **fictional character Noddy**.
 
• The **first book series **featuring **Noddy **was released **between 1949 and 1963**.
 
• It was **illustrated by Dutch artist **Harmsen van der Beek from **1949 till his passing in 1953**, after which Peter Wienk completed the project.
 
• Since **1955, **the persona has been the subject of **television programs on British television**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Joanne Rowling **is a **British novelist **and **philanthropist **who also goes by the **pen name J. K. Rowling**.
 
• She was the author of the **seven-volume children's fantasy series Harry Potter**, which was launched** from 1997 to 2007**.
 
• **Author Ruskin Bond **is **Anglo-Indian**. The **Room on the Roof**, his debut book, was **released in 1956 **and was **awarded the John Llewellyn Rhys Prize in 1957**. More than **500 short stories, essays, and novels by Bond**, including **64 picture books for kids**, have been published.
 
• **Leo Tolstoy**, also known as **Count Lev Nikolayevich Tolstoy**, was **a Russian author **who is revered as **one of literature's finest voices**.
